ns2:section.sectionText: NOTE: Students registering for this course will be registered for the following courses by the School of Music: MUS 199, Section 240 -- additional one hour of credit for the course EDPR 203 - This course is for 0 credit but carries the "Clinical Experience Fee" of $676. Students may NOT register for this course until they have passed the Illinois Basic Skills Test and the University of Illinois has received this score. The student will then be given a 1TCH attribute which is necessary to add MUS 240 and the other courses.
